Ventino is Ela's top Last.fm similar at 1.0 but carries no audience figure anywhere in the file, so it cannot be sized or assigned to either group.
No Spotify, Instagram or TikTok evidence appears in the file, and no source_status rows record those queries — the absence is unexplained rather than confirmed empty.

markets.evidence_basis: Geography here rests entirely on proxies: Last.fm crowd tags (lastfm.tag.colombia, lastfm.tag.bogota) and related/similar-artist adjacency on two platforms (deezer.related.*, lastfm.similar.*). The only hard scale figures are platform-wide and country-blind: 71087 Last.fm listeners with 1562506 plays (lastfm.listeners, lastfm.playcount), 5858 Deezer fans (deezer.fans), and 575000 YouTube subscribers against 492216352 views across 134 videos (youtube.subscribers, youtube.total_views, youtube.video_count). Note the large gap between YouTube scale and Deezer fan count — that asymmetry is real in the file but cannot be resolved into territory splits.
caveats: No free source in this file exposes listeners by country. Every market claim above is inference from tags and adjacency, not measured geography.
Related-artist edges reflect co-listening and catalogue similarity, not where fans live. Aitana's 348001 Deezer fans say nothing about this artist's Spanish audience.
The Bogotá and Colombia tags may reflect the artist's origin rather than an active local audience; tag counts are not shown.
YouTube's 492216352 views are unsegmented — they could be concentrated in one territory or spread across all Spanish-speaking markets, and this file cannot distinguish the two.
